up: List all distinct molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4613209. For each molecule, return the following fields: molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), preferred name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), maximum development phase (from molecule_dictionary.max_phase), molecule type (from molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Only include molecules that have a canonical SMILES entry in compound_structures. Use the compound_records table to link the document to molecules via doc_id, then join to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Do not add any additional filters or limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4613209'
